world.country.ae.lore: Home to G42 and the Stargate UAE campus (opening in Abu Dhabi in 2026 under the 2025 bilateral chip-access deal), the UAE was already the world's first country with a dedicated AI minister; in May 2026 it dramatically quit OPEC after six decades of membership — a sign of how far its strategy has pivoted from oil quotas toward AI-and-compute-driven diversification.
world.country.ae.name: United Arab Emirates
world.country.af.lore: Now in a declared state of open war with Pakistan (since February 2026, following a devastating March airstrike on a Kabul hospital) alongside a persistent ISIS-Khorasan insurgency, leaving zero capacity or interest in AI/technology policy.
world.country.af.name: Afghanistan
world.country.am.lore: A surprisingly deep post-Soviet engineering talent pool, reinforced by the Tumo tech-education network and a wave of 2022-era Russian tech-worker relocation, fuels a modest IT-services export sector; PM Pashinyan's Civil Contract party won reelection in June 2026 amid a fragile peace process with Azerbaijan.
world.country.am.name: Armenia
world.country.ao.lore: Oil-dependent economy with negligible domestic AI development; the long-ruling MPLA continues to dominate politics.
world.country.ao.name: Angola
world.country.ar.lore: Globant remains Latin America's largest AI-services exporter; the Milei government's ideological courtship of foreign AI-infrastructure capital (including a stalled Stargate Argentina LOI) has yet to yield a operating hyperscale campus.
world.country.ar.name: Argentina
world.country.at.lore: A quiet, research-oriented AI profile (IST Austria) without significant hyperscale datacenter capacity; sits in the DACH cluster's shadow next to Germany and Switzerland.
world.country.at.name: Austria
world.country.au.lore: Canva's design-AI unicorn success and CSIRO's Data61 research anchor a growing AI sector, while proposed 'mandatory guardrails' for high-risk AI remain under consultation rather than law; Australia will host the expanded 24-team 2027 Rugby World Cup.
world.country.au.name: Australia
world.country.bd.lore: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party's supermajority win and the passage of the 'July Charter' referendum in February 2026 finalized the post-Hasina political transition, though AI/digital policy remains a low state priority.
world.country.bd.name: Bangladesh
world.country.be.lore: Brussels hosts the EU institutions that write and enforce the AI Act, giving Belgium outsized regulatory influence relative to its small domestic AI sector.
world.country.be.name: Belgium
world.country.bf.lore: Ruled by a military junta under Ibrahim Traoré since 2022, fighting a grinding jihadist insurgency that controls large swaths of territory.
world.country.bf.name: Burkina Faso
world.country.bg.lore: Joined the eurozone as its 21st member on January 1, 2026, after a volatile political year that saw Iliana Iotova become first female president and Rumen Radev's new 'Progressive Bulgaria' coalition sweep the April 2026 parliamentary election.
world.country.bg.name: Bulgaria
world.country.br.lore: Latin America's largest compute and AI market, anchored by a 2024 Nvidia sovereign-AI partnership, but its comprehensive AI bill (PL 2338) remains stalled in the Chamber of Deputies; hosts the 2027 FIFA Women's World Cup.
world.country.br.name: Brazil
world.country.by.lore: The Hi-Tech Park Minsk IT boom that once produced firms like EPAM has been hollowed out by the 2020-21 political crackdown, mass tech-worker emigration, and sanctions tying Minsk ever closer to Moscow.
world.country.by.name: Belarus
world.country.ca.lore: Deep-learning research pedigree (Hinton/Bengio legacy) persists in Montreal and Toronto even as commercial gravity shifts south; federal AI legislation stalled with 2025 prorogation, leaving policy to a voluntary code.
world.country.ca.name: Canada
world.country.cd.lore: Produces the majority of the world's cobalt and a huge share of its tantalum (coltan) — both essential to electronics and battery supply chains — even as the M23 conflict and disasters like the January 2026 Rubaya mine collapse (600+ dead) show how little of that mineral wealth reaches domestic technological capacity.
world.country.cd.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
world.country.ch.lore: The Alps supercomputer (CSCS) cracked the world top-10 in the June 2026 TOP500 list, and the ETHZ/EPFL 'Apertus' project is Europe's flagship fully-open sovereign LLM; Geneva will host the 2027 global AI Summit.
world.country.ch.name: Switzerland
world.country.ci.lore: West Africa's fastest-growing large economy, with a nascent Abidjan fintech scene but no meaningful sovereign AI/compute program yet.
world.country.ci.name: Ivory Coast
world.country.cl.lore: Prime South American hyperscaler target thanks to Atacama solar and rule-of-law stability, but local water-use backlash (e.g. Google's modified Cerrillos project) has already forced design changes.
world.country.cl.name: Chile
world.country.cm.lore: A long-running Anglophone-region conflict and Boko Haram spillover in the north constrain state capacity far more than any AI ambitions, under long-serving President Biya.
world.country.cm.name: Cameroon
world.country.cn.lore: Peepseek's January 2025 open-weight model shock — echoed by a 17%, ~$600bn single-day Nvidia stock plunge in January 2026 — proved China can match frontier performance on far less compute; a June 2026 Chinese system ('LineShine') reclaimed the world's #1 TOP500 supercomputer spot from the US for the first time since 2022, even as comprehensive export controls keep pushing Huawei's Ascend chips and SMIC's fabs into overdrive.
world.country.cn.name: China
world.country.co.lore: Medellín's scrappy startup scene continues but sovereign compute is minimal; a sharp right-populist swing in the June 2026 presidential runoff (de la Espriella over Cepeda) followed strong legislative gains for outgoing president Petro's party, injecting fresh policy uncertainty.
world.country.co.name: Colombia
world.country.cu.lore: Full US embargo blocks essentially all advanced-chip access; 2026 saw Havana and Washington open talks on easing the oil blockade even as former leader Raúl Castro faced a fresh US indictment, underscoring how far AI-era compute remains from Cuban reach.
world.country.cu.name: Cuba
world.country.cy.lore: Held the rotating EU Council presidency from January 2026; a May 2026 legislative election returned Annita Demetriou's Democratic Rally with a plurality.
world.country.cy.name: Cyprus
world.country.cz.lore: One of the Democracy Index's 'full democracy' tier states; the Karolina EuroHPC supercomputer and a deep automotive-automation industry anchor its tech profile.
world.country.cz.name: Czechia
world.country.de.lore: Frankfurt remains Europe's largest datacenter hub despite high industrial power prices; a January 30, 2027 Federal Convention will elect a new president, while Helsing's defense-AI rise and Aleph Alpha's pivot to sovereign enterprise AI define the national AI narrative.
world.country.de.name: Germany
world.country.dk.lore: Led a multinational European troop deployment to Greenland (Operation Arctic Endurance, January 2026) after US threats against the island; PM Mette Frederiksen's coalition lost its parliamentary majority in the March 2026 election.
world.country.dk.name: Denmark
world.country.dz.lore: Hydrocarbon-dependent and politically closed, with a tightly-controlled July 2026 parliamentary election and negligible domestic AI/compute development.
world.country.dz.name: Algeria
world.country.ec.lore: Negligible domestic compute base; recurring drought-driven hydropower shortfalls and gang violence remain far bigger governance priorities than AI policy.
world.country.ec.name: Ecuador
world.country.ee.lore: The world's most digitized state (e-residency, X-Road) and host to NATO's cyber-defence center of excellence, punching far above its population in state-AI integration; a parliamentary election looms by March 2027, and Ülle Madise was elected president by the Riigikogu in September 2026.
world.country.ee.name: Estonia
world.country.eg.lore: A refreshed National AI Strategy and Microsoft cloud investment point toward a regional AI-hub ambition, but a currency crisis and IMF program constrain state capacity; Cairo hosted the 2027 African Games.
world.country.eg.name: Egypt
world.country.es.lore: AESIA, the EU's first dedicated national AI regulator, and the MareNostrum 5 EuroHPC supercomputer give Spain an outsized AI-governance and compute profile; a severe 2026 Ceuta migrant crisis and record heatwave wildfires tested state capacity through the summer.
world.country.es.name: Spain
world.country.et.lore: Cheap GERD hydropower and one of Africa's earliest dedicated AI institutes (EAII, 2020) coexist with real fragility — renewed Tigray-region clashes flared in January 2026 even as PM Abiy Ahmed won reelection that June.
world.country.et.name: Ethiopia
world.country.fi.lore: LUMI (Kajaani) and Google's seawater-cooled Hamina campus anchor a strong public and hyperscale compute base; a parliamentary election is scheduled for April 2027.
world.country.fi.name: Finland
world.country.fr.lore: Mistrial AI remains Europe's leading open-weight frontier-model challenger, backed by a state that hosted the February 2025 AI Action Summit; a presidential election is scheduled for April 2027 with Macron term-limited.
world.country.fr.name: France
world.country.gb.lore: Home to DeepMind and the world's first AI safety institute, but a comprehensive AI law remains unpassed; Keir Starmer resigned as PM in June 2026 and Andy Burnham was appointed by the King in July 2026 without a general election.
world.country.gb.name: United Kingdom
world.country.ge.lore: A small IT/BPO sector operates against a backdrop of democratic backsliding and stalled EU-accession hopes under the Georgian Dream government.
world.country.ge.name: Georgia
world.country.gh.lore: Hosts Google's first AI research lab in Africa (Accra, since 2019) and is often cited as a stable West African democracy, though domestic compute capacity remains modest.
world.country.gh.name: Ghana
world.country.gn.lore: Ruled by a military junta since the 2021 coup; parties aligned with junta leader Doumbouya won a May 2026 parliamentary election as he moves to formalize civilian-facing rule while retaining control.
world.country.gn.name: Guinea
world.country.gr.lore: Microsoft's Athens-area cloud region is ramping up as Greece's first real hyperscale presence; a parliamentary election must be held by July 2027.
world.country.gr.name: Greece
world.country.gt.lore: Negligible domestic compute base; regional nearshore BPO growth outpaces any sovereign AI ambitions.
world.country.gt.name: Guatemala
world.country.hk.lore: A legacy Asian financial and datacenter hub whose status has been complicated since the 2020 National Security Law and the 2020 US decision to treat it like the mainland for export-control purposes, pushing some hyperscale growth toward Singapore instead.
world.country.hk.name: Hong Kong
world.country.hu.lore: Viktor Orbán's 16-year Fidesz rule ended in a landslide April 2026 defeat to Péter Magyar's Tisza party — a political earthquake likely to reset Hungary's EU relations and any tech-sovereignty posturing built under the old government.
world.country.hu.name: Hungary
world.country.id.lore: New Jakarta/Batam-area hyperscale cloud regions anchor Southeast Asia's largest digital economy, though a devastating January 2026 West Java landslide (70+ dead) underscored the country's climate vulnerability even as AI investment ramps up.
world.country.id.name: Indonesia
world.country.ie.lore: Datacenters already consume roughly a fifth of Irish electricity, forcing grid operator EirGrid to keep a de facto moratorium on new large Dublin-area DC connections even as the country remains Big Tech's EU regulatory home.
world.country.ie.name: Ireland
world.country.il.lore: Wiz's 2025 sale to Google for roughly $32bn was the largest cybersecurity acquisition ever, underscoring an AI/cyber ecosystem fed by the Unit 8200 pipeline; the Gaza hostage crisis ended in January 2026, but growing international pressure (12 countries backing trade restrictions on settlement goods by September 2026) and Iran-war spillover into Lebanon continue to weigh on its diplomatic standing even as its tech sector booms.
world.country.il.name: Israel
world.country.in.lore: The IndiaAI Mission is subsidizing sovereign GPU capacity at unprecedented scale even as Bangalore/Hyderabad's IT-services giants pivot toward AI; New Delhi hosted the February 2026 AI Impact Summit and signed a landmark EU free-trade agreement that same January, while a Gen-Z-style protest wave hit Delhi in June 2026.
world.country.in.name: India
world.country.iq.lore: Elected Kurdish politician Nizar Amidi (PUK) as president in April 2026, continuing the post-2003 power-sharing system; caught in the 2026 Iran war's crossfire, with Iran-aligned drone strikes launched from Iraqi territory hitting Saudi pipeline infrastructure in September 2026.
world.country.iq.name: Iraq
world.country.ir.lore: Devastated by the 2026 Iran war: Israeli/US strikes killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in February, his son Mojtaba succeeded him in March, and a US-brokered ceasefire (the Islamabad Memorandum) collapsed again by July. Iran enters 2027 economically isolated (Washington's August 'Economic D-Day' campaign), militarily degraded, and almost entirely cut off from legal compute access.
world.country.ir.name: Iran
world.country.is.lore: A cheap-geothermal-power niche compute haven; an August 2026 referendum on continuing EU membership negotiations was rejected, keeping Iceland outside the bloc while it stays aligned via the EEA.
world.country.is.name: Iceland
world.country.it.lore: Hosts the Leonardo and HPC6 EuroHPC supercomputers at CINECA and one of the EU's first national AI statutes; a March 2026 constitutional referendum on judicial reform was decisively rejected.
world.country.it.name: Italy
world.country.jp.lore: Rapidus's ambitious 2nm fab project and a distinctively pro-innovation 'AI Promotion Act' (2025) signal an industrial-policy bet on reclaiming chip and AI leadership; PM Sanae Takaichi's February 2026 landslide reelection secured a supermajority for policy continuity.
world.country.jp.name: Japan
world.country.ke.lore: Nairobi pioneered mobile money and is now a global hub for AI data-labeling/RLHF outsourcing work, while Microsoft and G42 jointly build a major geothermal-powered datacenter; deadly March 2026 floods and a youth protest wave tested the Ruto government.
world.country.ke.name: Kenya
world.country.kh.lore: Minimal legitimate domestic AI development; internationally notorious instead for large-scale cyber-fraud/scam compounds (Sihanoukville and elsewhere) that have drawn regional law-enforcement crackdowns.
world.country.kh.name: Cambodia
world.country.kp.lore: No civilian AI sector to speak of, but the Reconnaissance General Bureau's Lazarus Group remains among the world's most prolific cryptocurrency thieves and weapons-program cyber operators; Kim Jong Un further consolidated dynastic control through a February 2026 party congress and a landslide March 2026 parliamentary election.
world.country.kp.name: North Korea
world.country.kr.lore: Samsung and SK Hynix's dominance of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) makes South Korea as indispensable to the AI buildout as any GPU designer; its comprehensive AI Basic Act took effect in January 2026.
world.country.kr.name: South Korea
world.country.kz.lore: Cheap coal power previously drew a wave of crypto-mining capacity; President Tokayev has now consolidated power through a new constitution and a redesigned 'Kurultai' legislature.
world.country.kz.name: Kazakhstan
world.country.lk.lore: Still rebuilding from its 2022 sovereign default and IMF program, with negligible domestic AI/compute development; co-hosted the 2026 Men's T20 Cricket World Cup with India.
world.country.lk.name: Sri Lanka
world.country.lu.lore: A financial and legal data-haven punching well above its population in datacenter capacity, and home to the EU Court of Justice that will adjudicate early AI Act disputes.
world.country.lu.name: Luxembourg
world.country.ma.lore: UM6P has become a notable pan-African AI research investment, and Morocco is positioning itself as a data-gateway hub between Africa and Europe; the 2026 Ceuta migrant crisis (roughly 80,000 crossings) strained ties with Spain.
world.country.ma.name: Morocco
world.country.mg.lore: Among the world's poorest countries with negligible digital infrastructure; vanilla and mineral exports dominate the economy.
world.country.mg.name: Madagascar
world.country.ml.lore: The military junta lost significant territory — including Kidal and parts of Gao, Mopti and Sevare — to a joint jihadist-separatist offensive in April 2026, a state visibly in retreat with no capacity for technology policy.
world.country.ml.name: Mali
world.country.mm.lore: A January 2026 election widely condemned as neither free nor fair handed the military-backed USDP a supermajority, formalizing junta rule five years after the 2021 coup; the ongoing civil war leaves zero capacity for technology policy.
world.country.mm.name: Myanmar
world.country.mt.lore: Labour's Robert Abela won a fourth consecutive term in the May 2026 general election; Malta will host the 2027 Commonwealth Youth Games.
world.country.mt.name: Malta
world.country.mw.lore: One of the world's poorest countries with negligible digital infrastructure or AI policy.
world.country.mw.name: Malawi
world.country.mx.lore: Nearshoring boom is dragging in the country's first hyperscale cloud regions (AWS Querétaro 2025) even as the 2025 dissolution of transparency watchdog INAI raised data-governance concerns; a February 2026 military strike killed cartel kingpin 'El Mencho'.
world.country.mx.name: Mexico
world.country.my.lore: Johor's datacenter boom — absorbing overflow from Singapore's building moratorium with huge Microsoft, Google, AWS and Nvidia-linked investment since 2024 — has made Malaysia one of the fastest-growing compute markets on Earth, though 2024's chip-transshipment scrutiny showed Washington watching Malaysian re-export routes to China closely.
world.country.my.name: Malaysia
world.country.mz.lore: Minimal domestic AI/compute footprint; state capacity remains focused on the Cabo Delgado jihadist insurgency and developing major offshore LNG reserves.
world.country.mz.name: Mozambique
world.country.ne.lore: Ruled by a military junta since the 2023 coup, itself the target of a failed August 2026 counter-coup attempt against junta leader Tiani; no meaningful technology-policy apparatus exists amid chronic instability.
world.country.ne.name: Niger
world.country.ng.lore: Lagos's 'Yabacon Valley' makes Nigeria Africa's largest startup ecosystem by funding volume, but a chronically unreliable power grid remains the binding constraint on serious compute build-out; Boko Haram violence continued in 2026 (162 killed in a February attack in Kwara State).
world.country.ng.name: Nigeria
world.country.nl.lore: ASML's EUV lithography monopoly makes the Netherlands the single most important chokepoint in the global chip supply chain; Amsterdam-area hyperscale growth remains capped by a grid-connection moratorium, and D66 leader Rob Jetten was sworn in as PM in February 2026 heading a minority government.
world.country.nl.name: Netherlands
world.country.no.lore: The ~$1.8 trillion Government Pension Fund Global makes Norway one of the largest passive shareholders in every major AI company on Earth; King Harald V died in August 2026 and was succeeded by King Haakon VIII.
world.country.no.name: Norway
world.country.np.lore: The Gen-Z-aligned, anti-establishment Rastriya Swatantra Party (led by Kathmandu mayor Balen Shah) swept to a landslide parliamentary win in March 2026, continuing the political realignment triggered by 2025's youth-led unrest.
world.country.np.name: Nepal
world.country.nz.lore: Microsoft's first Azure region opened in 2024, giving New Zealand modest domestic hyperscale capacity for the first time, layered atop Rocket Lab's Māhia launch site and a growing agri-tech AI sector; a perennial top-5 finisher in the Democracy Index.
world.country.nz.name: New Zealand
world.country.pa.lore: A regional financial and subsea-fiber hub rather than a compute one; the Canal Authority increasingly leans on optimization AI to manage traffic amid drought-driven water constraints.
world.country.pa.name: Panama
world.country.pe.lore: Extreme political churn continued into 2026 — President Jerí was censured and removed in February, succeeded by Balcázar, before Keiko Fujimori won the presidency in a mid-year runoff — leaving digital/AI policy a low priority amid institutional crisis.
world.country.pe.name: Peru
world.country.ph.lore: The world's BPO/call-center capital faces existential disruption risk from generative AI even as government has no binding AI framework yet; a June 2026 magnitude-7.8 earthquake (the strongest since 1976) added to a string of natural disasters through the year.
world.country.ph.name: Philippines
world.country.pk.lore: A 2023 draft National AI Policy remains largely aspirational as the state wages a declared 'open war' against the Afghan Taliban (from February 2026, including a March airstrike on a Kabul hospital that killed 400+) alongside an intensifying Balochistan insurgency.
world.country.pk.name: Pakistan
world.country.pl.lore: Warsaw's new hyperscale cloud regions and Krakow's Cyfronet supercomputing center make Poland Central Europe's fastest-rising digital hub; a parliamentary election is due by November 2027.
world.country.pl.name: Poland
world.country.pt.lore: The Sines 'Start Campus' is becoming one of Europe's largest new hyperscale hubs; Socialist António José Seguro won the February 2026 presidential runoff, and Storm Kristin caused catastrophic damage that same January.
world.country.pt.name: Portugal
world.country.qa.lore: Channels sovereign wealth into global AI stakes rather than a large domestic compute base; hosts the 2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup while remaining exposed to the region's Iran-war-driven Gulf and Red Sea security tensions.
world.country.qa.name: Qatar
world.country.ro.lore: A large IT-outsourcing workforce is repositioning toward AI-services delivery even without a major hyperscale campus of its own yet.
world.country.ro.name: Romania
world.country.ru.lore: Cut off from Western chips since 2022, Russia leans on Sberbank's GigaChat/Kandinsky and Yandex's domestic stack, smuggled Nvidia hardware, and deepening compute dependence on China; the New START nuclear arms-control treaty with the US expired in February 2026 with no successor.
world.country.ru.name: Russia
world.country.sa.lore: Backing 'Humain' as a national AI champion, Riyadh is trying to buy its way to AI-superpower status alongside NEOM and a packed 2027 sporting calendar (AFC Asian Cup, Arab Games, Olympic Esports Games, WrestleMania 43); it is simultaneously leading a new 14-nation Red Sea naval coalition and an August 2026 defense pact with Turkey and Pakistan amid the Iran war and Houthi attacks on its own pipeline and coastline.
world.country.sa.name: Saudi Arabia
world.country.sd.lore: Locked in a devastating civil war between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces since April 2023 — RSF drone strikes hit Khartoum's airport as recently as May 2026 — Sudan has no functioning apparatus for anything resembling AI or technology policy.
world.country.sd.name: Sudan
world.country.se.lore: The Arctic 'Node Pole' around Luleå is one of Europe's premier cold-climate green-compute sites; a narrow September 2026 election win returned a left-wing government under Magdalena Andersson.
world.country.se.name: Sweden
world.country.sg.lore: Asia's most sophisticated AI-governance and compute hub — ranked #3 globally in the Tortoise Global AI Index — even though its own datacenter moratorium history shows the physical limits of a small, energy-import-dependent city-state; much of the overflow demand it can't host lands next door in Johor, Malaysia.
world.country.sg.name: Singapore
world.country.sn.lore: A relatively stable West African democracy under the new Sonko/Faye government pursuing a 'Senegal Digital 2034' strategy, though still far from any real compute build-out.
world.country.sn.name: Senegal
world.country.so.lore: A weak central state fighting a long-running al-Shabaab insurgency has no capacity for technology policy of any kind; among the world's least digitized countries.
world.country.so.name: Somalia
world.country.ss.lore: The world's youngest country remains one of its most fragile — a March 2026 attack in Unity State killed 169 — underscoring how far it is from any technology-policy capacity.
world.country.ss.name: South Sudan
world.country.sy.lore: The interim post-Assad government spent 2026 consolidating control — defeating and then absorbing the Kurdish-led SDF into the Syrian Army (ending the Rojava autonomous administration in August) and winning an August 2026 removal from the US state-sponsor-of-terrorism list that reopens the door to foreign investment — while a Damascus court sentenced the ousted Assad and top lieutenants in absentia for war crimes.
world.country.sy.name: Syria
world.country.td.lore: Among the least digitized states on Earth, with negligible electrification let alone AI infrastructure; hosts a large refugee burden from Sudan's civil war.
world.country.td.name: Chad
world.country.th.lore: New AWS/Azure cloud regions are landing in Bangkok even as the country undergoes its own constitutional rewrite — a referendum to begin drafting a new constitution passed alongside PM Anutin Charnvirakul's February 2026 election plurality.
world.country.th.name: Thailand
world.country.tr.lore: Baykar's Bayraktar combat drones (with AI-assisted targeting) are among the decade's most successful defense-tech exports; Turkey hosted the July 2026 NATO summit in Ankara and signed new regional pacts (a Saudi-Pakistan-Turkey defense agreement, a Hejaz railway revival with Riyadh) amid the 2026 Iran war's regional spillover.
world.country.tr.name: Turkey
world.country.tw.lore: TSMC's fabs are the single most important chokepoint in the entire global AI compute stack, making the island's 'silicon shield' against China existential to the whole industry; a nuclear-phaseout reversal debate reflects real strain between AI-driven power demand and grid capacity.
world.country.tw.name: Taiwan
world.country.tz.lore: Minimal domestic AI development; will co-host the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations alongside Kenya and Uganda.
world.country.tz.name: Tanzania
world.country.ua.lore: The war with Russia has turned Ukraine into the world's most intensive live testbed for autonomous drone/ISR AI (the state-backed Brave1 cluster), even as its 'Diia' app remains one of the most advanced digital-government platforms anywhere.
world.country.ua.name: Ukraine
world.country.ug.lore: President Museveni's disputed January 2026 reelection — amid fraud allegations, deadly protests, and the abduction of opposition leader Bobi Wine — entrenched nearly four decades of continuous rule; will co-host the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations.
world.country.ug.name: Uganda
world.country.us.lore: Home to the frontier AI labs and the largest compute build-out on Earth (Stargate, hyperscaler capex arms race), but a 17%/~$600bn single-day Nvidia stock plunge in January 2026 exposed real 'AI bubble' anxiety; Washington's rescinded diffusion rule now runs on bilateral chip deals (UAE, Saudi Arabia) even as it clashes with allies over Greenland.
world.country.us.name: United States
world.country.uz.lore: Reform-oriented but still tightly state-directed; e-government digitization outpaces any AI-specific industrial policy.
world.country.uz.name: Uzbekistan
world.country.ve.lore: State authority collapsed after a January 2026 US strike captured Nicolás Maduro; acting president Delcy Rodríguez governs an unstable transition further battered by deadly June 2026 earthquakes, leaving no functioning digital or AI policy apparatus.
world.country.ve.name: Venezuela
world.country.vn.lore: General Secretary Tô Lâm's April 2026 election as President as well — an unprecedented consolidation of the party's top two posts in one person — cements a centralizing turn even as FPT and VinAI push a genuine, state-encouraged AI-services boom.
world.country.vn.name: Vietnam
world.country.ye.lore: Civil war escalated sharply again in 2026: the Southern Transitional Council dissolved after losing Aden in January, and the Houthis spent the year blockading and then seizing the Bab-el-Mandeb strait itself, choking Red Sea shipping and Saudi Arabia's own pipeline exports.
world.country.ye.name: Yemen
world.country.za.lore: The only African country with a full public hyperscaler region (AWS af-south-1) and home to Naspers/Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors — but chronic Eskom load-shedding remains the single biggest constraint on serious compute expansion.
world.country.za.name: South Africa
world.country.zm.lore: A relatively stable multiparty democracy — Hichilema's UPND won reelection in August 2026 — with negligible domestic AI/compute development.
world.country.zm.name: Zambia
world.country.zw.lore: Chronic power shortages and a sanctioned, ZANU-PF-dominated political economy leave little room for AI development; an August 2026 Lake Kariba ferry disaster (97 dead) underscored broader infrastructure fragility.
world.country.zw.name: Zimbabwe
